title: Induction Machine Field-Oriented Control (Single-Phase)
text: Per-unit discrete-time single-phase induction machine field-oriented control, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Control mode}, {Rated electrical frequency (Hz)} sets the rated electrical frequency, {Number of pole pairs}, {Main winding rotor resistance, Rar’ (Ohm)} sets the main winding rotor resistance, {Main winding rotor leakage inductance, Llar’ (H)} sets the main winding rotor leakage inductance, {Main winding mutual inductance, Lms (H)} sets the main winding mutual inductance, {Auxiliary/main windings turn ratio} sets the auxiliary-to-main windings turn ratio, {Fundamental sample time (s)} sets the block sample, {Control sample time (s)} sets the control sample, {Speed controller proportional gain} sets the speed controller proportional gain, {Speed controller integral gain} sets the speed controller integral gain, {Speed controller integral anti-windup gain} sets the speed controller integral anti-windup, {Maximum torque (Nm)} sets the maximum torque, {Minimum torque (Nm)} sets the minimum torque, {Rated flux (Wb)} sets the rated flux, {Control type} sets the control type, {Current hysteresis band (A)} sets the current hysteresis band, {A-phase current proportional gain} sets the main winding current proportional gain, {A-phase current integral gain} sets the main winding current integral gain, {A-phase current anti-windup gain} sets the main winding current anti-windup gain, {B-phase current proportional gain} sets the auxiliary winding current proportional, {B-phase current integral gain} sets the auxiliary winding current integral gain and {B-phase current anti-windup gain} sets the auxiliary winding current anti-windup gain. Values come from the instance.
